text:
maya_g: Quick q — we're evaluating Sable-8B for Dedicated customers. The upstream repo has a weird clause that says 'research only' and an attribution requirement. Can we (a) redistribute quantized weights to Dedicated customers, and (b) run it for commercial inference in our hosted offering?

olivia_ml: Link to license?

maya_g: https://example.com/sable8b/LICENSE (copied from upstream). Key bits: 'non-commercial use only' + 'attribution required when publicizing outputs'. Also there's a note about 'no further redistribution of model weights without permission'. :thinking:

samir_k: If it literally says "no redistribution of model weights" then shipping quantized checkpoints to customers would be risky. Even sending 4-bit quantized weights counts as redistribution.

lee_ops: What about running it in-host (we host inference and return tokens) vs handing them files? Hosted inference probably ok depending on license because we're not redistributing weights, but commercial use clause would block paid service.

olivia_ml: Right. Two separate axes: redistribution (sharing files) and commercial use (charging for inference). Both need explicit allowance. The license text here seems to forbid both.

maya_g: For Dedicated customers we often provide pinned model artifacts in a customer VPC. Some customers want the bundle copied into their infra (air-gapped). That's effectively redistribution. So we need a checklist: can we allow Dedicated copy, or must we proxy only?

dev-legal-bot: @maya_g Filing legal intake: please add model URL, exact license version, and intended usage (hosted API, Dedicated copy, Private on-prem). Legal will triage.

maya_g: Added details to the intake form (link pasted). For now: priority customers want Dedicated copy and also enterprise redistributable license if possible.

samir_k: Another angle — is the upstream permissive to derivative weights? Some licenses say you can modify but not redistribute original weights. Quantization arguably creates a derivative. But many licensors still treat that as redistribution. Need explicit permission.

olivia_ml: Also confirm attribution requirements: if they require attribution on outputs, that could force us to add boilerplate to every generated response or logs, which is a compliance and UX problem. Ask legal whether attribution can be limited to model card and docs rather than per-response.

maya_g: One more technical nuance — some folks think we can distill to a smaller model and avoid restrictions. Distillation still produces a derived model; if license forbids commercial use or redistribution of derivatives, it may be prohibited.

lee_ops: For experiments we ran 4-bit quant and evals locally (accuracy: -0.9% on MMLU) — if we share eval reports that's fine, but sharing the actual quant weights may cross the line.

samir_k: Agreed. Proposed temporary mitigation: (1) Block exporting of Sable-8B weights from infra unless legal signs off; (2) Allow running in-host (not in the paid hosted tier) only for eval/trial under internal 'research-only' flag; (3) Disable any 'download weights' in Dedicated onboarding until license is cleared.

olivia_ml: Sounds good. Also flag product implications: customers expecting to bring model on-prem will need an alternative or a licensing addendum from upstream. Sales should be notified.

maya_g: Can legal confirm whether an explicit downstream license from upstream could permit redistribution of quantized/checkpoint artifacts? If yes, what's typical ask: a commercial redistribution license + disclaimer removal?

dev-legal-bot: Legal intake received. Initial guidance: if upstream has 'research-only' we cannot offer commercial hosted inference nor redistribute weights. Legal will reach out to the upstream contacts for commercial licensing terms and attribution scope. Expect 3-5 business days.

infra-bot: Note: I revoked export permission for model_id="sable-8b" on dev clusters (per samir_k request) at 2026-03-20T15:04Z.

maya_g: Thanks. For the eval/quantization experiment notes — should we keep the eval logs in the public benchmark repo? They don't include weights, just metrics and prompts.

samir_k: Yes metrics are fine. Add a model-card snippet that states license and usage constraints so evaluators don't assume it's redistributable. Example header:```
Model: Sable-8B
License: Research-Only (see upstream link)
Allowed: internal evals only
Not allowed: commercial hosting, redistribution of weights
```

olivia_ml: Good. I'll draft a short README update and ping sales/legal.

maya_g: OK leaving this thread open. If legal allows an addendum we can re-evaluate quant export. For now: no redistribution, hosted inference blocked unless license changed, only internal evals permitted. :thumbsup:
